literal_instruction_execution.label: expects_machine_to_infer_intent
literal_instruction_execution.description: Learner believes the computer can infer what the programmer intended.

literal_instruction_execution.label: ignores_literal_instruction_order
literal_instruction_execution.description: Learner believes exact written instruction order does not matter.

instruction_precision.label: vague_instruction_is_sufficient
instruction_precision.description: Learner believes vague instructions are enough for a computer.

instruction_precision.label: precision_not_required
instruction_precision.description: Learner believes programming instructions do not need exact details.

input_process_output.label: confuses_input_and_output
input_process_output.description: Learner confuses information entering a system with produced results.

input_process_output.label: omits_processing_stage
input_process_output.description: Learner believes input becomes output without processing.

task_decomposition.label: solves_task_as_one_step
task_decomposition.description: Learner treats a complex task as one indivisible step.

task_decomposition.label: decomposition_order_confusion
task_decomposition.description: Learner breaks a task into steps but places them in an incorrect logical order.

programming_language_purpose.label: programming_language_only_for_math
programming_language_purpose.description: Learner believes programming languages are only used for calculations.

programming_language_purpose.label: programming_language_is_human_language
programming_language_purpose.description: Learner believes a programming language behaves exactly like ordinary natural language.

human_to_machine_instructions.label: computer_understands_natural_language_directly
human_to_machine_instructions.description: Learner believes computers directly understand unrestricted human language.

human_to_machine_instructions.label: code_not_needed_for_instructions
human_to_machine_instructions.description: Learner believes formal code is unnecessary for giving machine instructions.

python_as_programming_language.label: python_is_only_an_application
python_as_programming_language.description: Learner believes Python is merely an application rather than a programming language.

python_as_programming_language.label: python_not_used_to_write_programs
python_as_programming_language.description: Learner does not recognize Python as a language for writing executable programs.

python_environment.label: python_environment_is_code
python_environment.description: Learner confuses the execution environment with the Python program itself.

python_environment.label: environment_not_required
python_environment.description: Learner believes Python code can always run without a Python environment or interpreter.

code_editor.label: editor_executes_code_by_itself
code_editor.description: Learner believes a code editor alone executes Python code.

code_editor.label: editor_and_interpreter_same
code_editor.description: Learner confuses a code editor with the Python interpreter.

basic_setup.label: installation_not_required
basic_setup.description: Learner assumes Python can always run without installation or environment setup.

basic_setup.label: setup_steps_order_confusion
basic_setup.description: Learner misunderstands the basic order of installing, opening an editor, and running code.

print_statement.label: print_changes_variable_value
print_statement.description: Learner believes print() changes the stored value of a variable.

print_statement.label: print_only_accepts_text
print_statement.description: Learner believes print() can display only strings.

displaying_output.label: output_is_same_as_input
displaying_output.description: Learner confuses program output with user input.

displaying_output.label: output_not_visible_until_saved
displaying_output.description: Learner believes output must be stored in a variable before it can be displayed.

print_syntax.label: missing_parentheses_in_print
print_syntax.description: Learner omits required parentheses in Python print().

print_syntax.label: quotes_required_for_all_print_values
print_syntax.description: Learner believes every value passed to print() must be inside quotation marks.

program_execution.label: code_runs_without_execution
program_execution.description: Learner believes written code produces results without being executed.

program_execution.label: execution_order_random
program_execution.description: Learner believes Python normally executes statements in random order.

running_python_code.label: run_command_not_needed
running_python_code.description: Learner believes typing code automatically runs it in all environments.

running_python_code.label: runs_wrong_file_confusion
running_python_code.description: Learner misunderstands which Python file is being executed.

reading_program_output.label: reads_code_instead_of_output
reading_program_output.description: Learner reports the source code rather than the result it produces.

reading_program_output.label: output_order_confusion
reading_program_output.description: Learner predicts displayed output in the wrong order.

variable_concept.label: variable_is_permanent_value
variable_concept.description: Learner believes a variable can never change once assigned.

variable_concept.label: variable_is_literal_container_name
variable_concept.description: Learner confuses the variable name with the value stored in it.

variable_assignment.label: assignment_direction_reversed
variable_assignment.description: Learner interprets x = 5 as assigning x into 5.

variable_assignment.label: assignment_means_equality_test
variable_assignment.description: Learner confuses assignment with checking equality.

variable_naming.label: variable_name_can_start_digit
variable_naming.description: Learner believes Python variable names may begin with a digit.

variable_naming.label: spaces_allowed_in_variable_names
variable_naming.description: Learner believes spaces may appear directly inside a variable name.

integer_type.label: integer_requires_quotes
integer_type.description: Learner believes integer values must be written inside quotation marks.

integer_type.label: integer_can_contain_decimal
integer_type.description: Learner believes values with decimal points are integers.

string_type.label: string_without_quotes_is_text
string_type.description: Learner believes arbitrary text without quotes is automatically a string.

string_type.label: string_is_numeric_when_digits_inside
string_type.description: Learner believes a quoted sequence of digits behaves automatically as a number.

number_vs_text.label: quoted_number_is_numeric
number_vs_text.description: Learner believes a quoted number is numerically equivalent to an integer.

number_vs_text.label: number_and_string_operations_same
number_vs_text.description: Learner believes numbers and strings behave identically in expressions.

variable_reassignment.label: reassignment_keeps_old_value
variable_reassignment.description: Learner believes assigning a new value does not replace the old one.

variable_reassignment.label: reassignment_creates_second_variable
variable_reassignment.description: Learner believes assigning again to the same name creates a separate variable.

state_change.label: state_never_changes
state_change.description: Learner does not recognize that a variable's stored value can change over time.

state_change.label: state_change_is_automatic
state_change.description: Learner believes variable state changes without executing an assignment.

assignment_tracing.label: uses_initial_value_after_reassignment
assignment_tracing.description: Learner keeps using the first assigned value after a later reassignment.

assignment_tracing.label: assignment_trace_order_confusion
assignment_tracing.description: Learner traces assignments in the wrong execution order.

addition.label: addition_concatenates_numbers
addition.description: Learner treats numeric addition like string concatenation.

addition.label: addition_operand_confusion
addition.description: Learner incorrectly identifies the values participating in an addition.

subtraction.label: subtraction_order_ignored
subtraction.description: Learner believes a-b and b-a give the same result.

subtraction.label: subtraction_used_on_strings
subtraction.description: Learner believes ordinary string values can be directly subtracted.

arithmetic_expressions.label: left_to_right_only
arithmetic_expressions.description: Learner ignores operator precedence and evaluates strictly left to right.

arithmetic_expressions.label: operator_precedence_confusion
arithmetic_expressions.description: Learner applies arithmetic operators in an incorrect precedence order.

expression_evaluation.label: expression_not_reduced_to_value
expression_evaluation.description: Learner does not recognize that an expression evaluates to a resulting value.

expression_evaluation.label: uses_wrong_intermediate_result
expression_evaluation.description: Learner makes an incorrect intermediate calculation while evaluating an expression.

string_concatenation.label: concatenation_performs_numeric_addition
string_concatenation.description: Learner believes joining strings adds their numeric meanings.

string_concatenation.label: concatenation_inserts_space_automatically
string_concatenation.description: Learner believes concatenation automatically inserts spaces.

combining_text.label: text_combines_without_operator
combining_text.description: Learner believes separate string variables combine automatically.

combining_text.label: mixed_types_combine_directly
combining_text.description: Learner believes strings and integers can always be concatenated without conversion.

concatenation_errors.label: ignores_type_error_in_concatenation
concatenation_errors.description: Learner expects string + integer to work without conversion.

concatenation_errors.label: uses_subtraction_for_text_joining
concatenation_errors.description: Learner uses an inappropriate operator to combine strings.

if_statement.label: if_runs_unconditionally
if_statement.description: Learner believes the body of an if statement always runs.

if_statement.label: if_requires_else
if_statement.description: Learner believes every if statement must have an else block.

boolean_condition.label: condition_must_be_number
boolean_condition.description: Learner believes a condition must specifically be a numeric value.

boolean_condition.label: true_false_mean_text
boolean_condition.description: Learner treats True and False as ordinary strings rather than boolean results.

conditional_execution.label: both_paths_execute
conditional_execution.description: Learner believes all conditional blocks execute regardless of the condition.

conditional_execution.label: condition_checked_after_body
conditional_execution.description: Learner believes the body executes before the condition is tested.

indentation.label: indentation_is_optional
indentation.description: Learner believes indentation has no structural meaning in Python.

indentation.label: wrong_block_indentation
indentation.description: Learner places a statement in the wrong conditional or loop block.

if_else.label: if_and_else_both_execute
if_else.description: Learner believes both branches of if/else execute.

if_else.label: else_has_own_condition
if_else.description: Learner believes else requires another explicit condition.

two_way_decision.label: two_way_decision_runs_two_results
two_way_decision.description: Learner believes a two-way decision chooses both outcomes.

two_way_decision.label: decision_not_based_on_condition
two_way_decision.description: Learner does not associate branch choice with the evaluated condition.

branch_selection.label: selects_branch_by_position
branch_selection.description: Learner chooses a branch based on its position rather than condition truth.

branch_selection.label: reverses_true_false_branch
branch_selection.description: Learner executes the else branch when the condition is true and vice versa.

conditional_tracing.label: incorrect_condition_trace
conditional_tracing.description: Learner evaluates a condition incorrectly while tracing.

conditional_tracing.label: incorrect_branch_output
conditional_tracing.description: Learner predicts output from the wrong branch.

for_loop.label: for_loop_missing_structure
for_loop.description: The learner forgets the colon or indentation required to form a valid for loop.

for_loop.label: loop_body_scope_confusion
for_loop.description: The learner cannot distinguish statements inside the loop body from statements that run after the loop.

iteration.label: iteration_processes_all_at_once
iteration.description: The learner believes iteration processes the entire collection simultaneously instead of one item per pass.

iteration.label: iteration_order_confusion
iteration.description: The learner believes items may be processed randomly or skipped rather than visited sequentially.

range.label: range_endpoint_inclusive
range.description: The learner believes the ending value of range is included.

range.label: range_count_confusion
range.description: The learner incorrectly determines how many iterations a range will produce.

loop_variable.label: loop_variable_is_collection
loop_variable.description: The learner believes the loop variable contains the entire collection instead of the current single item.

loop_variable.label: loop_variable_is_list_name
loop_variable.description: The learner confuses the loop variable with the name of the collection being iterated over.

loop_variable.label: loop_variable_never_changes
loop_variable.description: The learner believes the loop variable keeps the same value throughout all iterations.

for_loop_tracing.label: incorrect_iteration_trace
for_loop_tracing.description: The learner cannot correctly track the loop variable and output from one iteration to the next.

for_loop_tracing.label: incorrect_final_output
for_loop_tracing.description: The learner predicts the wrong complete output after tracing all iterations of the loop.

while_loop.label: while_runs_fixed_times
while_loop.description: Learner believes a while loop always runs a predetermined number of times.

while_loop.label: while_condition_checked_once
while_loop.description: Learner believes the while condition is checked only before the first iteration.

loop_condition.label: loop_continues_when_false
loop_condition.description: Learner believes a loop continues even after its condition becomes false.

loop_condition.label: condition_not_rechecked
loop_condition.description: Learner believes the loop condition is not reevaluated after each iteration.

iteration_update.label: update_not_needed
iteration_update.description: Learner believes a changing loop variable does not need to be updated.

iteration_update.label: update_direction_confusion
iteration_update.description: Learner updates the loop variable in a direction that prevents the intended termination.

infinite_loop.label: infinite_loop_caused_by_many_iterations
infinite_loop.description: Learner believes any loop with many iterations is automatically infinite.

infinite_loop.label: fails_to_recognize_unchanged_condition
infinite_loop.description: Learner does not recognize that an unchanged true condition can cause an infinite loop.

while_loop_tracing.label: incorrect_while_iteration_count
while_loop_tracing.description: Learner predicts the wrong number of while-loop iterations.

while_loop_tracing.label: incorrect_while_state_trace
while_loop_tracing.description: Learner incorrectly tracks variable values through a while loop.

function_concept.label: function_is_variable
function_concept.description: Learner confuses a function with a stored ordinary value.

function_concept.label: function_runs_when_defined
function_concept.description: Learner believes defining a function automatically executes its body.

function_definition.label: missing_def_structure
function_definition.description: Learner omits or misuses def, parentheses, colon, or indentation.

function_definition.label: definition_executes_body
function_definition.description: Learner believes the statements inside a function execute immediately at definition time.

function_call.label: function_call_without_parentheses
function_call.description: Learner believes referring to a function name always calls it.

function_call.label: function_call_redefines_function
function_call.description: Learner believes calling a function creates a new definition.

function_body.label: function_body_scope_confusion
function_body.description: Learner cannot distinguish code inside the function from code outside it.

function_body.label: function_body_runs_without_call
function_body.description: Learner believes the function body executes even when the function is never called.

code_reuse.label: reuse_means_copy_paste_only
code_reuse.description: Learner believes code reuse only means manually copying code.

code_reuse.label: functions_do_not_reduce_repetition
code_reuse.description: Learner does not understand that functions can eliminate repeated code.

modularity.label: modularity_means_one_large_function
modularity.description: Learner believes modularity means putting all logic into one function.

modularity.label: modules_have_no_separation_role
modularity.description: Learner does not understand breaking a problem into independent reusable parts.

function_benefits.label: functions_only_make_code_shorter
function_benefits.description: Learner believes functions are useful only for reducing line count.

function_benefits.label: functions_not_reusable
function_benefits.description: Learner believes a function is intended to be used only once.

list_concept.label: list_holds_only_one_item
list_concept.description: Learner believes a list can store only one value.

list_concept.label: list_elements_must_be_unique
list_concept.description: Learner believes duplicate values cannot appear in a list.

list_creation.label: list_requires_parentheses
list_creation.description: Learner uses parentheses instead of square brackets for basic list creation.

list_creation.label: commas_not_required_in_list
list_creation.description: Learner believes list elements do not need separators.

list_access.label: list_index_starts_at_one
list_access.description: Learner believes the first list item is at index 1.

list_access.label: index_is_the_value
list_access.description: Learner confuses an element's index with the element value.

list_iteration.label: iteration_returns_indices_only
list_iteration.description: Learner believes iterating directly over a list always gives indices.

list_iteration.label: list_iteration_skips_items
list_iteration.description: Learner incorrectly believes normal list iteration skips some elements.

dictionary_concept.label: dictionary_is_ordered_list_of_values
dictionary_concept.description: Learner treats a dictionary as if it were a simple list indexed only by position.

dictionary_concept.label: dictionary_has_no_keys
dictionary_concept.description: Learner does not understand that dictionary values are associated with keys.

key_value_pairs.label: key_and_value_are_same
key_value_pairs.description: Learner believes a dictionary key and its corresponding value are identical concepts.

key_value_pairs.label: duplicate_keys_store_multiple_values_automatically
key_value_pairs.description: Learner believes duplicate dictionary keys automatically preserve multiple separate values.

dictionary_access.label: dictionary_access_uses_position
dictionary_access.description: Learner accesses dictionary items by positional index instead of key.

dictionary_access.label: dictionary_key_quotes_always_optional
dictionary_access.description: Learner believes string dictionary keys never require quotation marks.

dictionary_usage.label: dictionary_used_only_for_numbers
dictionary_usage.description: Learner believes dictionaries are only suitable for numeric values.

dictionary_usage.label: dictionary_unsuitable_for_lookup
dictionary_usage.description: Learner does not recognize dictionaries as structures for key-based lookup.
